example.title: Meridian Highway culverts, 552 Avenue at 852 Road
example.place: north of Nebraska Highway 13, Pierce County, NE
example.source: Wikimedia Commons (Category:Meridian Highway culverts (Pierce County, Nebraska))

brief: Early state-highway reinforced-concrete culverts on the old Meridian Highway alignment: a twin-barrel concrete box/arch culvert with a plain concrete headwall and short flared wings, and single-barrel culverts whose headwalls end in tall square concrete pillars (highway marker posts) at the road edge. Shown in winter snow on a rural road junction with farm buildings and a feedlot nearby.

traits.railing_detail: concrete headwall with tall square end pillars
